job.rawJd:
General recruiter and networking profile, not an employer posting.

Target: Account Manager, Senior Account Manager, Account Supervisor, Client Services, Client Partner, and adjacent relationship-led delivery roles across agencies, brands, technology-enabled services, and other industries.

Core work: own client relationships; understand the business problem behind the request; translate priorities into clear briefs, scopes, budgets, timelines, and delivery plans; keep cross-functional teams aligned; use research, performance signals, and product understanding to make useful recommendations; and carry work from discovery through delivery.

Resume architecture: lead with eight years of direct account management, broken out by agency so title progression and tenure are visible. Keep the verified healthcare and pharma history as evidence, but frame it as transferable client leadership rather than the target industry. Follow with recent UX, enterprise product, team leadership, and AI implementation experience that strengthens the account-management case.

This package must be fit-gated again against each employer's actual job description before application. Renewals, retention, quota, expansion revenue, contract negotiation, Salesforce, CRM administration, and SaaS portfolio ownership remain unsupported unless a future evidence review establishes them.

Direct relationship ownership, budgets, integrated delivery, and title progression are the primary operating center; healthcare is the evidence base rather than the target industry, and later UX, product, and AI work provide supporting differentiation.

resume.summary: Eight years in agency account management took me from Account Coordinator to Account Supervisor, leading Fortune 500 client work with brand budgets up to $20M. I managed relationships, scopes, reporting, and delivery across agency teams and vendors. Since then, I've grown a UX team from 2 to 30, led research and product decisions, and built AI products that reached production. I'm returning to account management with a stronger grasp of both the client relationship and the product behind it.
